title: WHO indicator context to prototype concern mapping
purpose: Documentation only. These population-level indicators do not enter the classifier, change its output, or make referral decisions.

mapping.reason: TB incidence can contextualize respiratory presentation priorities; it cannot identify TB in a person and does not train the classifier.
Malaria incidence is population context only; fever is a nonspecific reported symptom and must not be interpreted as malaria.
Road-traffic mortality can contextualize injury preparedness; it does not predict an individual injury.
Maternal mortality supports service-priority context only; the prototype does not infer pregnancy risk.
Under-five mortality is a population outcome and not an individual presentation label.
Neonatal mortality is a population outcome and not an individual presentation label.
Aggregate NCD mortality risk gives service context only; no listed disease or cause is inferred for a patient.
Prevalence can contextualize service priorities; the prototype does not measure blood pressure or diagnose hypertension.
Stunting prevalence is nutritional population context; no nutritional-status classifier is implemented.
Wasting prevalence is nutritional population context; no nutritional-status classifier is implemented.
Air-pollution mortality can contextualize respiratory service priorities; it cannot attribute a patient’s symptoms to pollution.
Unsafe-WASH mortality can contextualize WASH and diarrhoeal service priorities; it cannot establish cause or exposure for a person.
National physician density does not locate or verify a nearby facility.
National nursing/midwifery density does not locate or verify a nearby facility.
National pharmacy workforce density does not locate or verify a nearby service.

unavailable_in_supplied_package.reason: No leading-causes dataset was present in 050_Bangladesh.zip; source cause names and values were not reconstructed.

mapping_policy: These links are narrative planning context only. WHO rates and estimates never enter runtime text classification, individual risk estimation, clinical actions, or automated referral.
